  Guidewire sells the core system of record that property-and-casualty insurers run their

  from one-time perpetual licences to ratable cloud subscriptions (Guidewire Cloud), with
  cloud ARR now 84% of total ARR. It monetises further through a partner/marketplace

  UNDERSTANDABILITY: HIGH. Revenue mechanics (ARR → subscription revenue), margin mechanics

  Both are shown because the framework mandates SBC expensing, and the honest result is

  *** THIS IS THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT FINDING IN SECTION 2. ***
  GWRE is a high-quality franchise whose economics are currently CONSUMED by stock-based
  compensation. The entire long-duration thesis rests on whether that reverses. My forecast
